verifiedLaunchReview.nativeApproval: In-memory, package-bound, monotonic 30-second deadline; consumed before startActivity on the Android UI thread
tests: Two JVM policy tests covering package mismatch, single consumption, expiry, revocation, clock rollback and process restart
Six mocked-bridge UI checks covering PIN/biometric launches, duplicate labels, repeated taps, canceled prompts, stale approval, removed/disabled targets and long labels
verifiedLaunchReview.physicalReview: Direct Presto launch after fingerprint and fallback PIN passed in 0.5.1 according to the user on 2026-10-13; other packages/devices and detailed stale-launch cases were not separately reported.
verifiedLaunchReview.externalOpeningEnforcement: Experimental package-only accessibility guard in 0.5.0; manual enable required and OEM limitations apply

protectionReview.activation: Explicit in-app consent plus manual Android Accessibility enable; no automatic grants
protectionReview.scope: Native package selections persist; Settings, launcher and active keyboard are excluded
protectionReview.detection: TYPE_WINDOW_STATE_CHANGED package only, no screen-content retrieval or gestures
protectionReview.shield: Focusable opaque secure accessibility overlay blocks touch/keyboard input. Back/Close retain protection if HOME fails; actual MainActivity lifecycle dismisses the shield for native verification.
protectionReview.approval: Five-second exact-package arrival allowance, then continuous foreground approval; leave/screen-off/reset/reconnect/restart revoke
protectionReview.physicalReview: Launcher, notification and Recents openings, re-entry, screen locking and opening after swiping GhostAuth away passed in 0.5.1 according to the user on 2026-10-13. Force-stop, service interruption, reboot, split-screen/PiP and other OEM scenarios remain unreported.
limitations: Content may briefly appear before event detection
Disabling Accessibility, force-stop, missing events or OEM suspension stop protection
Split-screen, PiP and notification previews are not guaranteed protected

fingerprintFirstReview.primary: Enabled strong biometric automatically starts for app-detail and trusted external protection requests; PIN is secondary
fingerprintFirstReview.screen: Minimal GhostAuth mark and fingerprint reader/retry control with bottom-right Use PIN instead; secure system prompt appearance controlled by Android
fingerprintFirstReview.launch: Successful biometric or fallback PIN directly opens the exact package without a success screen or extra Open tap; native single-use approval remains enforced
fingerprintFirstReview.failure: Nonmatch event shows an error without approval; cancellation and Android lockout retain retry/PIN options; canceled/replaced requests ignore late proof
fingerprintFirstReview.physicalReview: Passed for automatic fingerprint, direct launch, wrong-scan lock, PIN fallback, cancellation, re-entry and screen locking, based on the user report on 2026-10-13; further detailed cases remain unreported.

securityHistoryReview.store: AES-256-GCM authenticated versioned AtomicFile under noBackupFilesDir with an independent history Keystore alias; sync and read-back before publication
securityHistoryReview.retention: Latest 100 entries by insertion order, independent of clock rollback
securityHistoryReview.consent: First initialization honors the previously saved history choice; native consent is authoritative thereafter. Pausing retains existing data and stops new entries.
securityHistoryReview.clear: Confirmed Clear history deletes entries and invalidates older queued writes; preserves normal consent, native credentials, selections and lockout. Unreadable-store recovery pauses recording until explicitly enabled.
securityHistoryReview.auth: History snapshots cannot grant launch approval; only native app verification produces entries, with no credential management or sample/risk events
securityHistoryReview.physicalReview: Pending actual Keystore/file persistence across process restart/reboot, privacy consent, clear/retry and credential retention on a phone

appearanceReview.control: Settings → Dark mode; applied immediately and saved independently from app/privacy preferences
appearanceReview.nativeStore: ghostauth_appearance SharedPreferences, with separate frontend cache; browser appearance stored independently
appearanceReview.ui: Shared dark palette, readable primary actions/inputs/dialogs and dark brand rendering; app icons keep original colors
appearanceReview.native: DayNight resources, API 31+ application night mode, AppCompat mode, SystemBars icon style, saved WebView background and matching secure protection shield
appearanceReview.isolation: Appearance/reset operations do not alter credential vault, biometric key, selected-app scope or security history
appearanceReview.physicalReview: Pending real Android app/splash/biometric prompt/bar styling, OEM behavior and force-close/reboot retention

researchScope: Opt-in foreground motion collector compiled; JVM quality/retention/encryption and six mocked bridge UI checks pass. Physical sensor delivery, capture boundaries, native persistence/races and latency remain pending; no real pilot dataset or model.

research.control: Settings → Motion research, separate explicit opt-in; native movement consent additionally gates motion
research.storage: Independent AES-256-GCM research.v1 AtomicFile and Keystore alias; backup excluded; bounded summaries only
research.retention: 500 summaries / 10 MiB / 7 days, pruning on next research read/write; future-dated entries removed on rollback
research.lifecycle: Resumed + focused Activity only; stop on focus loss, pause, screen-off, cancel, settings/clear or destroy; no window restart after interruption
research.binding: Native callback and package match; successful native proof required for eligible candidates; PIN, nonmatch and canceled attempts cannot contribute features
research.physicalReview: Pending sensor availability/rate/gaps, prompt focus behavior, native persistence/clear races, battery impact and launch latency
